annotations: THE LANTERNS ARE LIT AND THE FIRE-TOWN GLOWS
beats.why_this_beat: Establishes the festival setting and the troupe gathering at the circle before any fire is introduced — the opening image of warmth and excitement.
April's private moment with her scar before she begins the call — anchoring her backstory and the weight she carries into this night.

annotations: STEP INTO THE CIRCLE AND KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
beats.why_this_beat: The call-and-response ritual in full swing — all five characters visible, the circle complete, the community of safety made visible before it breaks.
Shows the safety infrastructure in place — the towel held close (not at arm's length) and the spotter positioned — before the moment that tests them.
The breath count is the ritual's centering moment — the last beat of collective calm before the final step that will break.
The Blank Echo — the chapter's title moment. Mango's silence where the response should be, the unlit staff showing the skip BEFORE fire makes it dangerous, the safety circle visibly cracking.

annotations: breathe in for three — breathe out for four!
a pattern her paws learned long ago
beats.why_this_beat: The climax — the collective catch in action, all four friends plus April forming the safety diamond, the fire contained because the circle holds even when the refrain broke.
The moment after the catch — the safety diamond visible as a geometric shape, the fire contained, the circle restored. Relief before the emotional reckoning.
The closing image — Mango folded small, the staff extinguished, the silence where the echo should have been now filling the entire frame. No one can speak what just broke.
